source_row.rationale: N-acetylcysteine works by replenishing glutathione stores, which helps detoxify the toxic acetaminophen metabolite (NAPQI) responsible for liver injury, making it the antidote of choice for acetaminophen overdose, most effective when given early in the treatment course.
